description: M8 check script, seed 1, one player, with night mobs, as Patch 2 plays it: the debug tools make the Big House a Citadel (building 8, level 10, four cannon ports), put a Barn 20 m east (building 9) with two horses (ids 10, 11) and an ox (id 12), a siege kit 20 m west (catapult 13 with its crewmen 14 and 15, ballista 16 with crewman 17, bronze cannon 18 with crewmen 19 and 20, a finished Artillery workshop, building 21, 100 farm fare and the Siege engines, Gunpowder, Muskets and Cannons research; no munitions: Patch 2 cut all ammunition), a goblin village 80 m north (its huts include id 28) and a troop kit 20 m east and 20 m south of the Big House (a Barracks, building 46, a Forge, the materials and research of every tier); the Big House trains a long-melee spearman (troop product 4306, id 224); the Barracks trains a bronze cavalry rider (troop product 4640: cavalry, weapon and armour tier 4, id 361), who uses up horse 10 from the Barn and comes out mounted (Patch 2: cavalry trains at the Barracks on a horse from the nearest Barn); the Artillery workshop casts an iron cannon (engine product 2051, id 358), which rolls out with its two artillery crewmen (359, 360), their food paid with it (Patch 2: every engine rolls out with its full crew, and only artillery crewmen crew engines); the ox is hitched to the catapult and hauls it 40 m north, where its crew open fire on the goblin village by themselves: the first hut falls, the next kills take the village to war, and by dusk the catapult has broken most of the village and killed its goblins; horse 11 is hitched to the bronze cannon and hauls it up into one of the Citadel's ports, and the iron cannon's crew push it up into a second port, each crew following its cannon in; through night 0 the port cannons, the ballista and the catapult fire at the night mobs, and the rider attack-moves 40 m north-west, where his first blow on a zombie after a straight gallop is a charge (double damage, knocked back about a metre); at dawn the catapult shoots down the goblin warband and the rider rides home. Debug threats: 10 goblin village, 50 Barn, 51 siege kit, 52 gun kit, 53 Citadel, 54 troop kit, 55 mine kit, 60 on the late night mobs, 90 Morvath, 91 on a late wave. Products: 6 artillery crewman, 2048 + engine (0 catapult, 1 ballista, 2 bronze cannon, 3 iron cannon), 4096 + troop x 100 + weapon tier x 10 + armour tier. Moves are world units (8,000 per metre).
